issues.legal_issue: A counterclaim based on a cause of action that accrued before the defendant delivered its defence may be entertained after issues have been framed when the plaintiff’s evidence is still underway and no material prejudice is shown.
material_facts: The defendants filed their counterclaim about two and a half years after issues had been framed.
The cause of action underlying the counterclaim accrued before the defendants filed their written statement.
When the counterclaim was filed, the plaintiff’s evidence had begun but was not complete, and the defendants’ evidence had not begun.
No prejudice to the plaintiff from adjudicating the counterclaim along with the suit was shown.
issues.conclusion: The counterclaim was maintainable; the High Court’s order rejecting it was set aside and the trial court’s order accepting it was restored.
issues.legal_principle: Order VIII Rule 6A(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure permits a defendant to set up a counterclaim for a cause of action accruing before the defendant delivers its defence. Under Rule 6A(2)–(4), the counterclaim has the effect of a cross-suit, and is treated as a plaint. Applying Bollepanda P. Poonacha v. K.M. Madapa, (2008) 13 SCC 179, the Court held that the cause of action must accrue before the defence is delivered. Rohit Singh v. State of Bihar, (2006) 12 SCC 734, did not bar this counterclaim: there, evidence had closed and arguments had been heard, whereas evidence in this suit was ongoing. The Court also found no serious injustice, irreparable loss, or demonstrated prejudice that would justify rejecting the counterclaim.

rule.if: counterclaim_in_civil_suit and cause_accrued_before_defence and counterclaim_filed_after_issues and plaintiff_evidence_incomplete and defence_evidence_not_started and prejudice_not_shown

predicates.counterclaim_in_civil_suit: A defendant in a civil suit asserts a counterclaim against the plaintiff.
predicates.cause_accrued_before_defence: The cause of action supporting the counterclaim accrued before the defendant delivered its defence.
predicates.counterclaim_filed_after_issues: The defendant filed the counterclaim after the court framed issues in the suit.
predicates.plaintiff_evidence_incomplete: The plaintiff’s evidence had begun but had not been completed when the counterclaim was filed.
predicates.defence_evidence_not_started: The defendant’s evidence had not begun when the counterclaim was filed.
predicates.prejudice_not_shown: The opposing party did not show that adjudicating the counterclaim with the suit would prejudice it.

issues.definition: When a defendant in a civil suit files a counterclaim after issues are framed, but its cause of action accrued before its defence and the evidence is still at the stated stage without demonstrated prejudice, the counterclaim may be adjudicated with the suit.
